subject.title: [Feishu] 飞书群多机器人身份混乱问题

question: Should Feishu group sessions become account/app-scoped by default, and what migration should preserve existing group transcripts, bindings, and reply routes?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the fix changes durable session identity and can affect existing Feishu group history, account routing, and message delivery, so automation should not choose the permanent key contract alone.

options.title: Adopt Account-Scoped Group Sessions
options.body: Make Feishu group peer/session identity include the receiving account or app, add migration/doctor handling for old shared keys, and require tests plus live multi-bot proof.

options.title: Add Compatibility-Gated Opt-In
options.body: Keep current shared group keys by default and add an explicit scoped mode only if maintainers decide upgrade compatibility is more important than fixing existing multi-bot groups by default.

options.title: Document Current Limitation
options.body: Leave group sessions shared across Feishu accounts and document that same-group multi-bot setups need separate agents/groups until a broader identity design lands.

recommendation.title: Adopt Account-Scoped Group Sessions
recommendation.body: Make Feishu group peer/session identity include the receiving account or app, add migration/doctor handling for old shared keys, and require tests plus live multi-bot proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current signal from adjacent Feishu identity review and recent Feishu message-routing history.
